title: Index is stable while nullity jumps
promptMarkdown: For a Banach space $H$ consider $T_t:H\oplus\mathbb R^2\to H\oplus\mathbb R$, $T_t(x,a,b)=(x,ta)$. Compute kernel, cokernel and index for $t=0$ and $t\ne0$. Then explain using the Schur-complement reduction why every sufficiently small bounded perturbation of $T_0$ is Fredholm of the same index, even when it mixes the summands.
hintLadder: At zero the second output vanishes identically.
The index subtracts two finite numbers; calculate both.
Eliminate the mixed blocks using the invertible large block.
